int lower(int a, int b)
    return if a < b then a else b
int higher(int a, int b)
    return if a > b then a else b
int sum_values(const int[] values)
    answer := 0
    for item := values[]
        answer += item
    return answer
bool fits(const int[] left, const int[] right)
    for: j < #left
        if left[j] > right[j]
            return false
    return true
int[] combine(const int[] left, const int[] right, sign := 1)
    answer := left
    for: j < #answer
        answer[j] += sign * right[j]
    return answer
string vector_text(const int[] values)
    string[] parts := []
    for item := values[]
        parts = parts.append(string(item))
    return "(" + parts.join(",") + ")"
string people(const int[] values, separator := " ")
    string[] parts := []
    for item := values[]
        parts = parts.append("P{item}")
    return parts.join(separator)
T[] remove_at<T>(const T[] values, int at)
    T[] answer := []
    for: j < #values
        if int(j) != at
            answer = answer.append(values[j])
    return answer
string padded(string value, int width, right := false)
    while int(#value) < width
        value = if right then " " + value else value + " "
    return value
string trim_end(string value)
    while #value > 0 and value[int(#value) - 1] == " "
        value = value[0:<int(#value) - 1]
    return value
class Job(exists := false, int[] maximum := [], int[] allocation := [], created := 0)
class Waiting(int who, int[] amount, int since)
class Event(int stamp, string kind, int who, int[] amount, waited := 0)
class Model(int[] total := [], int[] available := [])
    jobs := array(100, fill = Job())
    Waiting[] queue := []
    Event[] events := []
class Saved(string label, Model data)
class Check(int[] order := [], int[] remaining := [], string[] trace_lines := [])
class Decision(string status, reason := "", int[] order := [], string[] trace_lines := [])
class Manager()
    data := Model()
    mode := "AVOID"
    policy := "ALLOC"
    tracing := false
    autodetect := false
    stamp := 0
    Saved[] saved := []
    string[] output := []
    int[] zeros()
        return array(#data.total, fill = 0)
    int queued(int who)
        for: j < #data.queue
            if data.queue[j].who == who
                return int(j)
        return -1
    int[] request_of(int who)
        int at := queued(who)
        return if at < 0 then zeros() else data.queue[at].amount
    int[] need_of(int who)
        return combine(data.jobs[who].maximum, data.jobs[who].allocation, -1)
    Check inspect(Model model, bool detection, bool verbose)
        work := model.available
        done := array(100, fill = false)
        int[] idle := []
        for: who < 100
            done[who] = not model.jobs[who].exists
            if model.jobs[who].exists and detection and sum_values(model.jobs[who].allocation) == 0
                done[who] = true
                idle = idle.append(who)
        tag := if detection then "detect" else "safety"
        result := Check()
        if verbose
            suffix := if #idle > 0 then " idle " + people(idle) else ""
            result.trace_lines = ["[{tag}] start work={vector_text(work)}{suffix}"]
        while true
            chosen := -1
            for: who < 100
                if done[who]
                    continue
                requirement := combine(model.jobs[who].maximum, model.jobs[who].allocation, -1)
                if detection
                    requirement = array(#work, fill = 0)
                    for waiting := model.queue[]
                        if waiting.who == who
                            requirement = waiting.amount
                if fits(requirement, work)
                    chosen = who
                    break
            if chosen < 0
                break
            done[chosen] = true
            work = combine(work, model.jobs[chosen].allocation)
            result.order = result.order.append(chosen)
            if verbose
                result.trace_lines = result.trace_lines.append("[{tag}] P{chosen} can finish, work={vector_text(work)}")
        for: who < 100
            if not done[who]
                result.remaining = result.remaining.append(who)
        if verbose and #result.remaining > 0
            result.trace_lines = result.trace_lines.append("[{tag}] stuck work={vector_text(work)} remaining {people(result.remaining)}")
        return result
    Decision decide(int who, int[] amount, bool reject, bool verbose)
        if reject
            if queued(who) >= 0
                return Decision("rejected", "process P{who} is blocked")
            if sum_values(amount) == 0
                return Decision("rejected", "zero vector")
            if not fits(amount, need_of(who))
                return Decision("rejected", "request exceeds need")
            if mode == "ORDER"
                last := -1
                for: j < #amount
                    if data.jobs[who].allocation[j] > 0
                        last = int(j)
                for: j <= last
                    if amount[j] > 0
                        return Decision("rejected", "resource order violation")
        if not fits(amount, data.available)
            return Decision("blocked", "insufficient resources")
        if mode != "AVOID"
            return Decision("granted")
        Model tentative := data
        tentative.available = combine(tentative.available, amount, -1)
        tentative.jobs[who].allocation = combine(tentative.jobs[who].allocation, amount)
        Check result := inspect(tentative, false, verbose)
        return Decision(if #result.remaining == 0 then "granted" else "blocked", if #result.remaining == 0 then "" else "unsafe state", result.order, result.trace_lines)
    void .record(string kind, int who, int[] amount, waited := 0)
        data.events = data.events.append(Event(stamp, kind, who, amount, waited))
    void .grant(int who, int[] amount)
        data.available = combine(data.available, amount, -1)
        data.jobs[who].allocation = combine(data.jobs[who].allocation, amount)
    void .retry_queue()
        at := 0
        while at < int(#data.queue)
            Waiting waiting := data.queue[at]
            Decision choice := decide(waiting.who, waiting.amount, false, tracing)
            output = output.concat(choice.trace_lines)
            if choice.status == "granted"
                .grant(waiting.who, waiting.amount)
                data.queue = remove_at(data.queue, at)
                output = output.append("unblocked P{waiting.who} {vector_text(waiting.amount)}")
                .record("unblocked", waiting.who, waiting.amount, stamp - waiting.since)
            else
                at += 1
    void .terminate(int who, string kind, retry_after := true)
        int[] released := data.jobs[who].allocation
        int at := queued(who)
        if at >= 0
            data.queue = remove_at(data.queue, at)
        data.available = combine(data.available, released)
        data.jobs[who].exists = false
        output = output.append("{kind} P{who} released {vector_text(released)}")
        .record(kind, who, released)
        if retry_after
            .retry_queue()
    int[][] enumerate_orders(int[] work, int[] prefix, bool[] used)
        all_done := true
        int[][] result := []
        for: who < 100
            if data.jobs[who].exists and not used[who]
                all_done = false
                if fits(need_of(who), work)
                    next_used := used
                    next_used[who] = true
                    result = result.concat(enumerate_orders(combine(work, data.jobs[who].allocation), prefix.append(who), next_used))
        if all_done
            result = result.append(prefix)
        return result
    string table_vector(int[] values)
        string[] parts := []
        for: j < #values
            parts = parts.append(padded(string(values[j]), int(#string(data.total[j])), true))
        return parts.join(" ")
    string table_row(string heading, string[] cells, int[] widths)
        result := padded(heading, 9)
        for: j < #cells
            result += "  " + padded(cells[j], widths[j])
        return trim_end(result)
    string[] cycles(bool resource_graph, int[] path, int[] types, int start)
        current := path[-1]
        string[] result := []
        for: next_id < 100
            if not data.jobs[next_id].exists
                continue
            int[] labels := []
            int[] wanted := request_of(current)
            for: j < #data.total
                if data.jobs[next_id].allocation[j] > 0 and (if resource_graph then wanted[j] > 0 else wanted[j] > data.available[j])
                    labels = labels.append(int(j))
            if not resource_graph and current == next_id
                labels = []
            for label := labels[]
                if next_id == start
                    text := "cycle: P{start}"
                    for: j < #types
                        if resource_graph
                            text += " -> " + "ABCDEFGH"[types[j]]
                        text += " -> P{path[j + 1]}"
                    if resource_graph
                        text += " -> " + "ABCDEFGH"[label]
                    result = result.append(text + " -> P{start}")
                elif next_id > start
                    seen := false
                    for prior := path[]
                        if prior == next_id
                            seen = true
                    if not seen
                        result = result.concat(cycles(resource_graph, path.append(next_id), types.append(label), start))
                if not resource_graph
                    break
        return result
    string[] .command(string[] tokens, int command_stamp)
        output = []
        stamp = command_stamp
        op := tokens[0]
        if op == "RESOURCES"
            int[] total_values := []
            for: 1 <= j < #tokens
                total_values = total_values.append(int(tokens[j]))
            data = Model(total_values, total_values)
            return ["resources {vector_text(data.total)}"]
        if op == "MODE" or op == "POLICY" or op == "TRACE" or op == "AUTODETECT"
            label := ""
            if op == "MODE"
                mode = tokens[1]
                label = "mode"
            elif op == "POLICY"
                policy = tokens[1]
                label = "policy"
            elif op == "TRACE"
                tracing = tokens[1] == "ON"
                label = "trace"
            else
                autodetect = tokens[1] == "ON"
                label = "autodetect"
            return ["{label} {tokens[1]}"]
        if op == "SNAPSHOT" or op == "RESTORE"
            at := -1
            for: j < #saved
                if saved[j].label == tokens[1]
                    at = int(j)
            if op == "SNAPSHOT"
                if at < 0
                    saved = saved.append(Saved(tokens[1], data))
                else
                    saved[at].data = data
                return ["saved {tokens[1]}"]
            if at < 0
                return ["error: unknown snapshot {tokens[1]}"]
            data = saved[at].data
            return ["restored {tokens[1]}"]
        if op == "SAFE" or op == "DETECT"
            any_jobs := false
            for job := data.jobs[]
                any_jobs = any_jobs or job.exists
            if op == "SAFE" and not any_jobs
                return ["safe: no processes"]
            Check check_result := inspect(data, op == "DETECT", tracing)
            output = check_result.trace_lines
            if op == "DETECT"
                output = output.append(if #check_result.remaining == 0 then "no deadlock" else "deadlocked: " + people(check_result.remaining))
            else
                output = output.append(if #check_result.remaining == 0 then "safe: " + people(check_result.order) else "unsafe: " + people(check_result.remaining) + " cannot finish")
            return output
        if op == "SEQUENCES"
            int[][] permutations := enumerate_orders(data.available, [], array(100, fill = false))
            if #permutations == 1 and #permutations[0] == 0
                return ["safe sequences: no processes"]
            output = ["safe sequences: {#permutations}"]
            for: j < lower(int(tokens[1]), int(#permutations))
                output = output.append(people(permutations[j]))
            return output
        if op == "DEFICIT"
            string[] parts := []
            for: j < #data.total
                limit := 0
                for: who < 100
                    if data.jobs[who].exists
                        limit += need_of(who)[j]
                value := "-"
                for: extra <= limit
                    Model trial := data
                    trial.available[j] += extra
                    if #inspect(trial, false, false).remaining == 0
                        value = string(extra)
                        break
                parts = parts.append(value)
            return ["deficit: (" + parts.join(",") + ")"]
        if op == "VICTIMS"
            int[] dead := inspect(data, true, false).remaining
            if #dead == 0
                return ["no deadlock"]
            best := dead
            best_sum := 2147483647
            for: mask < 2 ^ int(#dead)
                if mask == 0
                    continue
                int[] selected := []
                weight := 0
                Model trial := data
                for: j < #dead
                    if (mask / (2 ^ int(j))) % 2 == 1
                        who := dead[j]
                        selected = selected.append(who)
                        weight += sum_values(data.jobs[who].allocation)
                        trial.available = combine(trial.available, trial.jobs[who].allocation)
                        trial.jobs[who].exists = false
                if #selected > #best
                    continue
                preferred := #selected < #best or weight < best_sum
                if #selected == #best and weight == best_sum
                    for: j < #best
                        if selected[j] != best[j]
                            preferred = selected[j] < best[j]
                            break
                if preferred and #inspect(trial, true, false).remaining == 0
                    best = selected
                    best_sum = weight
            return ["victims: " + people(best)]
        if op == "RECOVER"
            count_aborted := 0
            while true
                Check detected := inspect(data, true, tracing)
                output = output.concat(detected.trace_lines)
                if #detected.remaining == 0
                    break
                if #tokens == 2
                    for who := detected.remaining[]
                        .terminate(who, "aborted", false)
                        count_aborted += 1
                    .retry_queue()
                    break
                chosen := detected.remaining[0]
                for who := detected.remaining[]
                    int score_chosen := if policy == "ALLOC" then -sum_values(data.jobs[chosen].allocation) elif policy == "NEED" then sum_values(need_of(chosen)) else data.jobs[chosen].created
                    int score_who := if policy == "ALLOC" then -sum_values(data.jobs[who].allocation) elif policy == "NEED" then sum_values(need_of(who)) else data.jobs[who].created
                    if score_who > score_chosen or (score_who == score_chosen and who > chosen)
                        chosen = who
                .terminate(chosen, "aborted")
                count_aborted += 1
            output = output.append(if count_aborted == 0 then "no deadlock" else "recovered: {count_aborted} aborted")
            return output
        if op == "STATE"
            string[] names := []
            for: j < #data.total
                names = names.append(padded("ABCDEFGH"[j], int(#string(data.total[j])), true))
            name_row := names.join(" ")
            width := int(#name_row)
            widths := [higher(10, width), higher(3, width), higher(4, width), higher(7, width)]
            output = [table_row("Process", ["Allocation", "Max", "Need", "Request"], widths), table_row("", [name_row, name_row, name_row, name_row], widths)]
            for: who < 100
                if data.jobs[who].exists
                    output = output.append(table_row("P{who}", [table_vector(data.jobs[who].allocation), table_vector(data.jobs[who].maximum), table_vector(need_of(who)), table_vector(request_of(who))], widths))
            output = output.append(table_row("Available", [table_vector(data.available)], widths)).append(table_row("Total", [table_vector(data.total)], widths))
            string[] queued_text := []
            for waiting := data.queue[]
                queued_text = queued_text.append("P{waiting.who} {vector_text(waiting.amount)} since t={waiting.since}")
            output = output.append("blocked queue: " + (if #queued_text == 0 then "empty" else queued_text.join(", ")))
            return output
        if op == "STATS"
            for: j < #data.total
                int used := data.total[j] - data.available[j]
                int percent := used * 1000 / data.total[j]
                wanted := 0
                for waiting := data.queue[]
                    wanted += waiting.amount[j]
                letter := "ABCDEFGH"[j]
                output = output.append("{letter}: allocated {used}/{data.total[j]} ({percent / 10}.{percent % 10}%), requested {wanted}")
            kinds := ["granted", "blocked", "unblocked", "released", "finished", "aborted", "cancelled"]
            counts := array(7, fill = 0)
            waited_sum := 0
            for event := data.events[]
                for: j < #kinds
                    if event.kind == kinds[j]
                        counts[j] += 1
                if event.kind == "unblocked"
                    waited_sum += event.waited
            string[] event_parts := []
            for: j < #kinds
                event_parts = event_parts.append("{kinds[j]} {counts[j]}")
            output = output.append("events: " + event_parts.join(", "))
            if counts[2] == 0
                output = output.append("waits: none")
            else
                average := waited_sum * 100 / counts[2]
                fraction := padded(string(average % 100), 2, true).split(" ").join("0")
                output = output.append("waits: {counts[2]} unblocked, total {waited_sum}, average {average / 100}.{fraction}")
            return output
        if op == "HISTORY"
            for event := data.events[]
                if #tokens == 2 and tokens[1] != event.kind and tokens[1] != string(event.who)
                    continue
                suffix := if event.kind == "unblocked" then " waited {event.waited}" else ""
                output = output.append("t={event.stamp} {event.kind} P{event.who} {vector_text(event.amount)}{suffix}")
            return if #output == 0 then ["no events"] else output
        if op == "WAITGRAPH" or op == "GRAPH"
            resource_graph := op == "GRAPH"
            if resource_graph
                for item := data.total[]
                    if item != 1
                        return ["error: not single-instance"]
                for: j < #data.total
                    for: who < 100
                        if data.jobs[who].exists and data.jobs[who].allocation[j] > 0
                            output = output.append("assign " + "ABCDEFGH"[j] + " -> P{who}")
                for: stage < 2
                    for: who < 100
                        if data.jobs[who].exists
                            int[] wanted := request_of(who)
                            int[] needed := need_of(who)
                            for: j < #data.total
                                if (stage == 0 and wanted[j] > 0) or (stage == 1 and needed[j] > 0 and wanted[j] == 0)
                                    label := if stage == 0 then "request" else "claim"
                                    output = output.append("{label} P{who} -> " + "ABCDEFGH"[j])
            else
                for: who < 100
                    if not data.jobs[who].exists
                        continue
                    int[] wanted := request_of(who)
                    for: other < 100
                        if other == who or not data.jobs[other].exists
                            continue
                        string[] labels := []
                        for: j < #data.total
                            if wanted[j] > data.available[j] and data.jobs[other].allocation[j] > 0
                                labels = labels.append("ABCDEFGH"[j])
                        if #labels > 0
                            output = output.append("P{who} -> P{other} on " + labels.join(","))
                if #output == 0
                    output = ["no wait edges"]
            string[] found_cycles := []
            for: who < 100
                if data.jobs[who].exists
                    found_cycles = found_cycles.concat(cycles(resource_graph, [who], [], who))
            if resource_graph
                for: a < #found_cycles
                    for: b < a
                        left_parts := found_cycles[a].split(" -> ")
                        right_parts := found_cycles[b].split(" -> ")
                        before := false
                        for: j < #left_parts
                            if j >= #right_parts
                                break
                            if left_parts[j] != right_parts[j]
                                if j % 2 == 1
                                    before = left_parts[j].codepoints()[0] < right_parts[j].codepoints()[0]
                                else
                                    lp := left_parts[j].split("cycle: ").join("").split("P").join("")
                                    rp := right_parts[j].split("cycle: ").join("").split("P").join("")
                                    before = int(lp) < int(rp)
                                break
                        if before
                            temporary := found_cycles[a]
                            found_cycles[a] = found_cycles[b]
                            found_cycles[b] = temporary
            return output.concat(if #found_cycles == 0 then ["no cycles"] else found_cycles)
        vector_command := op == "PROCESS" or op == "CLAIM" or op == "REQUEST" or op == "WHATIF" or op == "RELEASE" or op == "ADD" or op == "REMOVE"
        global_vector := op == "ADD" or op == "REMOVE"
        int who := if global_vector then 0 else int(tokens[1])
        int[] amount := []
        if vector_command
            beginning := if global_vector then 1 else 2
            for: beginning <= j < int(#tokens)
                amount = amount.append(int(tokens[j]))
            if #amount != #data.total
                return ["error: wrong vector length"]
        if not global_vector and op != "PROCESS" and not data.jobs[who].exists
            return ["error: unknown process P{who}"]
        if op == "PROCESS"
            if data.jobs[who].exists
                return ["error: duplicate process P{who}"]
            if not fits(amount, data.total)
                return ["error: max exceeds total"]
            data.jobs[who] = Job(true, amount, zeros(), stamp)
            return ["process P{who} max {vector_text(amount)}"]
        if op == "WHATIF" or op == "REQUEST"
            Decision choice := decide(who, amount, true, tracing)
            output = choice.trace_lines
            if op == "WHATIF"
                description := if choice.status == "granted" then "granted" else "{choice.status} ({choice.reason})"
                if choice.status == "granted" and mode == "AVOID"
                    description += ", safe sequence " + people(choice.order)
                return output.append("whatif P{who} {vector_text(amount)}: {description}")
            if choice.status == "rejected"
                return output.append("error: " + choice.reason)
            if choice.status == "granted"
                .grant(who, amount)
                .record("granted", who, amount)
                return output.append("granted P{who} {vector_text(amount)}")
            data.queue = data.queue.append(Waiting(who, amount, stamp))
            .record("blocked", who, amount)
            output = output.append("blocked P{who} {vector_text(amount)}: {choice.reason}")
            if autodetect
                Check detected := inspect(data, true, tracing)
                output = output.concat(detected.trace_lines)
                if #detected.remaining > 0
                    output = output.append("deadlock detected: " + people(detected.remaining))
            return output
        if op == "ABORT"
            .terminate(who, "aborted")
            return output
        if op == "CANCEL"
            int at := queued(who)
            if at < 0
                return ["error: process P{who} is not blocked"]
            amount = data.queue[at].amount
            data.queue = remove_at(data.queue, at)
            .record("cancelled", who, amount)
            return ["cancelled P{who} {vector_text(amount)}"]
        if not global_vector and queued(who) >= 0
            return ["error: process P{who} is blocked"]
        if op == "FINISH"
            .terminate(who, "finished")
            return output
        if op == "MAXGRANT"
            int[] answer := zeros()
            int[] needed := need_of(who)
            for: j < #answer
                for: candidate <= needed[j]
                    int[] trial := zeros()
                    trial[j] = candidate
                    if candidate == 0 or decide(who, trial, true, false).status == "granted"
                        answer[j] = candidate
            return ["maxgrant P{who}: {vector_text(answer)}"]
        if op == "CLAIM"
            if not fits(data.jobs[who].allocation, amount)
                return ["error: claim below allocation"]
            if not fits(amount, data.total)
                return ["error: max exceeds total"]
            Model trial := data
            trial.jobs[who].maximum = amount
            if mode == "AVOID"
                Check checked := inspect(trial, false, tracing)
                output = checked.trace_lines
                if #checked.remaining > 0
                    return output.append("error: claim makes state unsafe")
            data = trial
            output = output.append("claim P{who} max {vector_text(amount)}")
            .retry_queue()
            return output
        if sum_values(amount) == 0
            return ["error: zero vector"]
        if op == "RELEASE"
            if not fits(amount, data.jobs[who].allocation)
                return ["error: release exceeds allocation"]
            data.jobs[who].allocation = combine(data.jobs[who].allocation, amount, -1)
            data.available = combine(data.available, amount)
            .record("released", who, amount)
            output = ["released P{who} {vector_text(amount)}"]
            .retry_queue()
            return output
        if op == "ADD"
            data.total = combine(data.total, amount)
            data.available = combine(data.available, amount)
            output = ["added {vector_text(amount)} total {vector_text(data.total)}"]
            .retry_queue()
            return output
        if not fits(amount, data.available)
            return ["error: remove exceeds available"]
        reduced := combine(data.total, amount, -1)
        for item := reduced[]
            if item == 0
                return ["error: total must stay positive"]
        for job := data.jobs[]
            if job.exists and not fits(job.maximum, reduced)
                return ["error: max exceeds total"]
        Model trial := data
        trial.available = combine(data.available, amount, -1)
        trial.total = reduced
        if mode == "AVOID"
            Check checked := inspect(trial, false, tracing)
            output = checked.trace_lines
            if #checked.remaining > 0
                return output.append("error: removal makes state unsafe")
        data = trial
        return output.append("removed {vector_text(amount)} total {vector_text(data.total)}")
manager := Manager()
int count
scan(&count)
for: 1 <= command_stamp <= count
    string line
    scan(&line)
    lines := .manager.command(line.split(" "), command_stamp)
    for result_line := lines[]
        println(result_line)
